scientific_question: Why does the causally effective v2.3 local trace increase retained direct correctness by 0.30039 while changing sampled learned accuracy by only 0.00146?
core_hypothesis: The direct-causal and sampled-behavior estimands can diverge because stable-omitted relations have no self write, retained relations may already lie on a saturated correct policy margin, and nonorthogonal tensor addresses add cross-talk. A read-only cellwise decomposition can distinguish evidence availability, retained value conversion, and endpoint sensitivity without modifying v2.3.
claim_boundary: This analysis attributes the frozen seed-2101 v2.3 outcome. It does not change or rescue the registered v2.3 decision, select a new gain, establish population replication, redefine stable omission, or authorize a new trainable mechanism.
registration_timing: Frozen after the complete v2.3 result and before writing attribution code, replaying the frozen model for this analysis, or inspecting retained-versus-omitted cellwise margins.

execution_contract.device: visible CUDA GPU required for frozen neural replay
execution_contract.sampled_endpoint: Reproduce the existing frozen v2.3 sampled behavior with the same choice seed; primary attribution uses exact probabilities and contains no new choice sampling.

cell_contract.unit: subject by learned relation by query orientation; retain both orientations rather than averaging logits before the sigmoid
cell_contract.retention: R_sr=1 exactly when the frozen stable-omission subject relation gain is positive; the same R_sr labels both orientations
cell_contract.correct_signed_global_margin: g_sro = y_ro times the frozen v1 policy margin, where y_ro is +1 for higher-lower query order and -1 for lower-higher order
cell_contract.correct_signed_local_margin: ell_sro = y_ro times the frozen applied lambda_L local margin
cell_contract.exact_probabilities: pG=sigmoid(g/T), pD=sigmoid(d/T), and delta_p=pD-pG with T=0.25
cell_contract.relation_level_reporting: Average the two orientation-specific correct probabilities or signed margins only after computing each orientation-specific value

self_cross_decomposition.full_trace: L_T is the unchanged natural v2.3 trace
self_cross_decomposition.self_trace: L_r is replayed from only the support slots belonging to learned relation r, using the same normal encoded signed values and frozen lambda_L
self_cross_decomposition.identity: ell_full=ell_self+ell_cross for every subject, learned relation, and orientation within 1e-6
self_cross_decomposition.stable_omission: ell_self is exactly zero within 1e-7 whenever R_sr=0
registered_summaries: signed and absolute self, cross, and full contribution by retained status

primary_estimands.error_mass: E_R=sum R(1-pG), E_O=sum (1-R)(1-pG), and omitted fraction E_O/(E_R+E_O), with subject-bootstrap ratios computed from resampled subject totals
primary_estimands.boundary_crossing: Within retained cells report g<=0 and d>0 rescue, g>0 and d<=0 harm, plus denominators and subject-bootstrap rates
primary_estimands.exact_probability_change: Report delta_p by retained status, baseline pG saturation bins [0,0.5), [0.5,0.9), [0.9,0.99), [0.99,1.0], and the fraction of error mass removed
primary_estimands.local_only_partition: For P-off/L-intact report exact probability and hard correctness separately for retained and omitted cells; also report pure-local sigmoid(ell/T) and sign correctness
primary_estimands.sampled_endpoint_reproduction: Reproduce original-v1/local-off and dual-intact sampled learned, nonlearned, overall accuracy, and distance slope from the frozen v2.3 result
primary_estimands.slope_decomposition: For each subject and condition compute pair-level exact correct probability averaged over orientations. Decompose the OLS numerator sum (d-dbar)(p-pbar) and slope by learned-retained, learned-omitted, and nonlearned groups; group contributions must sum to the total within 1e-12.

decision_rules.omission_dominant: The participant-bootstrap lower bound for omitted error-mass fraction exceeds 0.50.
decision_rules.retained_local_sufficient: For P-off/L-intact, retained exact-probability lower bound exceeds 0.65, omitted upper bound is at most 0.55, and retained-minus-omitted paired lower bound exceeds 0.10.
decision_rules.retained_value_conversion_limited: Retained local sufficiency fails while retained self contribution has a positive bootstrap lower bound and retained cells account for at least half of v1 exact error mass.
decision_rules.exact_rescue_with_sampled_insensitivity: The paired lower bound for retained dual-minus-v1 exact probability exceeds zero while the frozen sampled learned-accuracy contrast interval contains zero.
decision_rules.address_interference_material: The retained mean absolute cross contribution is at least one third of the retained mean absolute self contribution.
decision_rules.slope_source: Name the group with the largest positive v1 exact-probability slope contribution and report every signed contribution; this is descriptive and does not redefine the v2.3 behavioral endpoint.

outcome_tree.dual_evidence_access: If omission_dominant and retained_local_sufficient pass, preserve storage/query/value sufficiency for retained evidence and next test whether a local branch can access weak/raw evidence that the global stable-omission bottleneck excludes. Do not increase gain or change the address.
outcome_tree.shared_value_transform: If retained_value_conversion_limited passes, preserve L_T storage/address and prospectively test a shared value or expression transform. Do not replace the address or use relation-specific parameters.
outcome_tree.confirmation_estimand_sensitivity: If exact_rescue_with_sampled_insensitivity passes without either mechanistic limitation above, do not change the model; revise only a future replication estimand prospectively while preserving the failed v2.3 endpoint.
outcome_tree.mixed_or_unresolved: If the registered diagnoses do not isolate one route, preserve all qualified decompositions and register a narrower read-only analysis before another trainable candidate.
